relationships.subject: D,L-methadone
relationships.evidence_quote: in two of the four spheroid models, treatment with D,L-methadone significantly enhanced cell growth (by up to 121%), especially after long-term exposure.

relationships.subject: D,L-methadone
relationships.evidence_quote: This is consistent with the observed attenuation of the inhibitory effects of cisplatin in three spheroid models when adding D,L-methadone.

key_findings: OPRM1 mRNA is expressed in 69% of ovarian cancer tissues, but D,L-methadone reduced cell viability independent of OPRM1 expression.
D,L-methadone enhanced growth of some patient-derived spheroids and attenuated cisplatin effects; no significant effect on VEGF secretion in cell lines.
